name: Gravel V3
summary: Extremely aggressive complete-bike pricing with carbon frame, fork, and integrated cockpit. Best treated as a value platform with incomplete frame-provenance disclosure.

frame.material_grade: High-modulus carbon fiber; exact fiber grade is not published
frame.construction: Current T47 Gravel V3 carbon chassis with internal routing, integrated carbon cockpit and hidden seatpost clamp; the official factory storefront describes monocoque construction, but no lay-up schedule or molding protocol is published
frame.stiffness_evidence: No independent exact-current-platform stiffness or deflection result was found; seller response and bottom-bracket-flex descriptions are not treated as measured evidence

observed_current_electronic_builds.note: The official brand account identifies a current Gravel V3 electronic build as R7170, 24-speed and hydraulic-disc. Exact cassette, wheels, package contents, price and warranty were not captured.
